title: Using Proof Dependencies to Manage Verification Projects
abstract: arXiv:2611.13250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verification technology now scales to sizable projects, but techniques for managing such projects fall short. There are no effective ways to assess the progress made so far and to determine which verification tasks to perform next. A key issue is that the successful run of a verification tool provides little indication about what has actually been achieved. The guarantees provided depend on the specifications of the verified code as well as any unverified assumptions made in the proofs, e.g., about the behavior of unverified libraries. Manual inspection of specifications and assumptions to determine progress is error-prone and prohibitively expensive.   In this paper, we present automated techniques to assess and guide verification projects. translated_title: 使用证明依赖关系来管理验证项目
translated_abstract: 验证技术如今已经能够扩展到规模可观的项目，但用于管理此类项目的技术仍然不足。目前没有有效的方法来评估迄今为止所取得的进展，也无法确定接下来应执行哪些验证任务。一个关键问题在于，验证工具的成功运行并不能充分说明实际取得了什么成果。所提供的保证依赖于已验证代码的规范，以及证明过程中做出的任何未经验证的假设，例如关于未验证库行为的假设。通过人工检查规范和假设来确定进展既容易出错，成本也高得令人望而却步。在本文中，我们提出了用于评估和指导验证项目的自动化技术。所有这些技术都采用自动证明依赖分析，该分析会为项目中的每个证明义务计算出证明该义务所需的规范、语句和假设。
tldr: 本文提出了基于自动证明依赖分析的自动化技术，通过为项目中的每个证明义务计算所需的规范、语句和假设，来评估验证项目的实际进展并指导后续验证任务的选择。
en_tdlr: This paper presents automated techniques based on automatic proof dependency analysis, which computes the specifications, statements, and assumptions needed for each proof obligation in a project, to assess verification progress and guide which verification tasks to perform next.
